Last modified: 5/6/2025

Wingz Inc. (“Wingz”) maintains an on-line enabled software-as-a-service platform (“Wingz Software”) where persons seeking transportation (“Passenger Clients”) can connect directly with drivers (“Driver Client”) to facilitate and book pre-arranged transportation in the Driver Client’s vehicle(s) and which enables payment of fees for that transportation (“Services”). Access to the Wingz Software is obtained through a mobile Internet Application (“Wingz Application” or the “Application”) owned and operated by Wingz (“Wingz” “We,” or “Us”) and licensed to the Driver Clients. In order to participate as a Driver Client (“You”), You become a licensed user of Wingz Software-as-a-Service and agree to these Terms and Conditions for authorized use of that software (“Software Client”). Subject to these Terms and Conditions between Wingz and You, as well as compliance with the Wingz Community Guidelines (which are available on the Wingz website at https://wingz.com/community-guidelines), You will have access to the Application to review and accept requests for service from Passenger Clients and to collect payment from those Passenger Clients.

PLEASE READ THESE TERMS AND CONDITIONS CAREFULLY. THESE TERMS AND CONDITIONS CONTAIN A MANDATORY INDIVIDUAL ARBITRATION AND CLASS ACTION/JURY TRIAL WAIVER PROVISION THAT REQUIRES THE USE OF BINDING ARBITRATION ON AN INDIVIDUAL BASIS TO RESOLVE DISPUTES.

NOW THEREFORE, for good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which is hereby acknowledged, the parties hereto agree as follows:

Acknowledgment and Acceptance of
Software-as-a-Service Terms and Conditions

These Terms and Conditions constitute an electronic contract that sets out the legally binding terms of the relationship between Wingz and You in Your capacity as a Driver Client and as a Software Client. Please read these Terms and Conditions carefully.

Wingz reserves the right to change, modify, remove, add to, and terminate these Terms and Conditions or any provision thereof, along with any other policy or procedure of Wingz, at any time, at its sole discretion, effective upon making the modified provisions available on the Application, with or without Your notice or consent. You are responsible for regularly reviewing these Terms and Conditions. Continued use of the Application after any such changes are made to these Terms and Conditions shall constitute Your consent to such changes.

Use of the Application is solely permitted to individuals who can form legally binding contracts under applicable law and who meet all applicable regulatory requirements for providing passenger transportation services in a personal vehicle. Accordingly, You must be at least 25 years old, have had for at least one year a valid license to drive a passenger vehicle in the jurisdiction in which You are providing Services, and be legally authorized to work in the United States to become a Driver Client. You must also not be legally barred from driving a ride-sharing vehicle perthe requirements of any applicable law, regulation or ordinance (for example, laws or regulations prohibiting individuals convicted of certain crimes from driving a vehicle through a Transportation Network Company (“TNC”). If You do not meet these legal qualifications, You are not permitted to be (or, if applicable, You must cease engaging as) a Driver Client or Software Client.  All Driver Clients performing services under these Terms and Conditions must also satisfy the credentialing and training requirements used by the relevant state and/or federal agencies or departments in the state(s) in which the Driver Client performs Services, along with any credentialing and training requirements used by Wingz.  Thus, if Your training or credentialing qualifications lapse, You may be suspended from the Platform. You understand and acknowledge that Wingz has the right to, at any time while You are providing Services pursuant to this Agreement, request confirmation, evidence, proof or any other documentation that Wingz may require to confirm that you are in compliance with these Terms and Conditions and any other policies or procedures implemented by Wingz.

By accessing the Application, You accept these Terms and Conditions and agree to the terms, conditions, and notices contained and/or referenced herein.

1.        DEFINITIONS

Capitalized terms are defined as set forth below or elsewhere in the Agreement.

1.1 “Services” means the services specified in a Wingz Request for services to be provided by a Driver Client to a Passenger Client; specifically, pre-arranged transportation services using the Application to connect Passenger Clients with Driver Clients who will provide transportation services using the Driver Client’s personal vehicle.

1.2 “Wingz Request” means a notice provided, through the Application, to one or more Driver Clients, which includes a description of the Services to be optionally provided by the Driver Client, the time by which at which the services are to be provided (the “Wingz Completion Date”) and the rate of payment associated with the Wingz Request(the “Payment”). An open request is a request for Services that has not yet been filled (“Open Request”). Driver Clients can use the Application to review Open Requests and optionally decide to accept Open Requests. Once a Driver Client has accepted a Wingz Request pursuant to Section 2, the Wingz Request will become a “Wingz Engagement.”

1.3 “Wingz Mobile Application” or “Application” means the proprietary software application that Wingz licenses to Passenger Clients and Driver Clients to facilitate the provision of Services.

2.         DRIVER CLIENT’S OBLIGATIONS

2.1 Background Checks. As part of Your initial registration with Wingz, You agree to immediately execute a written consent for Wingz to conduct a background check (which may include but not be limited to a criminal history check, motor vehicle record check, and drug and/or alcohol screening) to be conducted by an independent third party. Subject to satisfactory completion of any and all required background checks (which will be conducted in compliance with all applicable laws) and agreement to the terms herein, You will be eligible to use the Wingz Mobile Application to view and accept Wingz Requests. Such background checks also may be conducted at any time while providing Services under these Terms and Conditions.

2.2 Automobile Insurance. You agree to maintain at Your cost automobile insurance valid for transporting passengers arranged through a transportation network company (TNC) and a valid driver’s license. You are advised that personal automobile insurance policies typically do not provide coverage when a driver uses a vehicle in connection with a transportation network company's online-enabled application or platform and that personal automobile insurance policies typically do not provide collision or comprehensive coverage for damage to the vehicle used by the driver when the driver is giving a ride or on his way to go pick up a client who requested a ride through a transportation company. You understand and agree that Wingz’s commercial automobile insurance policy does not provide coverage to You or Your vehicle(s) in the event of an accident or other loss. You further agree that, in the event of an accident while providing services to a Passenger Client, You will comply with any applicable law, ordinance, or regulation; make any required contact with or report to Your insurance carrier; and have available for law enforcement inspection evidence of Your personal insurance and Wingz’s commercial insurance.

2.3 Other Insurance. You acknowledge that You are a Driver Client and as such an independent contractor, not anemployee of Wingz. As such, unless otherwise required by applicable law, ordinance or regulation, You are not covered by any insurance that may be provided by Wingz to its employees, including, without limitation, health insurance, workers’ compensation insurance, general liability insurance, and automobile liability insurance. As an independent contractor, You are solely and exclusively responsible for and agree to provide Your own insurance. Specifically, in the event that You are injured while in the course and scope of an engagement sourced through Wingz, You acknowledge, understand and agree that You will not be covered by any workers’ compensation insurancecoverage that Wingz may provide to its employees. Further, in the event that Your actions cause an injury to a third party while You are in the course and scope of an engagement sourced through Wingz, You acknowledge and understand that You will not be covered by any general liability or automobile liability insurance coverage that Wingz may have, and that Wingz is not making any commitment to defend and/or indemnify You in such circumstances, and specifically denies such obligation.

2.4 Vehicle Used To Provide Services. In providing Services to Passenger Clients, You agree, consistent with applicable law, ordinance or regulation, to use street-legal coupes, sedans, hatchbacks, convertibles, or light-duty vehicles including vans, minivans, sport utility vehicles (SUVs) and pickup trucks and that such vehicles are not modified significantly from factory specifications (e.g., no stretch vehicles). You understand and agree that the acceptability of Your vehicle for use in providing Services to Passenger Clients is in Wingz’ sole discretion. You also agree that You will not transport more than seven (7) passengers on any one ride (or exceed the maximum occupancy of the vehicle if such maximum occupancy is lower than seven (7)). You further agree that Your vehicle used to provide Services to Passenger Clients is in good operating condition and meets the industry safety standards and all applicable statutory and state department of motor vehicle requirements for a vehicle of its kind and that any and all applicable safety recalls have been or will be remedied per manufacturer instructions. You will be solely responsible for any and all liability which results from or is alleged as a result of the operation of the vehicle You use to transport Passenger Clients, including, but not limited to personal injuries, death and property damages.

2.5 Compliance With Non-Discrimination Requirements. You represent that You understand and agree to comply with all legal requirements to provide services on a nondiscriminatory basis, including refraining from harassment, with respect to sex, race, color, religion, ancestry, national origin, disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation and any other basis protected by applicable law.

2.6 Vehicle Inspection. Wingz has the sole discretion to accept or reject Your vehicle for use in performing the Services based upon the results of the inspection or any other criteria determined solely by Wingz, in its sole and absolute discretion. You agree to conduct a vehicle inspection of the vehicle You intend to use to provide services to Wingz’s Passenger Clients, to the extent required by applicable law, regulation or ordinance. Any legally required inspection must be satisfactorily completed before You may provide driving services to Passenger Clients.

2.7 Obey All Laws. You agree to follow all applicable laws, ordinances and regulations when providing services to a Passenger Client, including but not limited to obeying all traffic laws and regulations.

2.8 Zero Tolerance Cell Phone Policy. Cell phones should only be used in connection with providing Services while You are providing Services. You must use hands-free technology when making calls while driving and any such calls should be limited to emergency calls only. You are prohibited from activities like texting, browsing the internet, or watching videos on Your phone or any other mobile or electronic device while actively transporting any Passenger Clients or providing any Services under this Agreement, with Your primary focus being on maintaining safe driving practices and minimizing distractions. Using GPS navigation applications is permitted as long as such applications are set up before driving and only voice commands are used while driving. You understand and agree that Passenger Clients will be encouraged to report to Wingz any violation of this policy and that You will be deactivated from providing services to Passenger Clients until completion of Wingz’s investigation of the incident and that these Terms and Conditions may be terminated if Wingz’s investigation determines that You violated the policy.

2.9 Zero Tolerance Intoxicating Substance Policy. Consistent with its legal obligations, Wingz has adopted a Zero Tolerance Intoxicating Substances Policy, a copy of which will be provided to You during Your product orientation.You understand and agree that Passenger Clients will be encouraged to report to Wingz any violation of the policy and that You will be deactivated from providing services to Passenger Clients until completion of Wingz’s investigation of the incident and that these Terms and Conditions may be terminated if Wingz’s investigation determines You violated the policy.

2.10 Accepting Open Requests. By registering to become a Driver Client and accepting an Open Request, You agree to use Your best efforts to perform the Wingz Engagement such that the Services are satisfactory to the PassengerClient for whom the Open Request was created. Once a Driver Client has accepted a Wingz Request, the Open Request will no longer be available for performance by other Driver Clients who received the Open Request. By accepting an Open Request, You are entering into a binding legal agreement to provide the Services for the Payment specified in the Open Request. Do not accept an Open Request unless You are sure that You understand what You arebeing asked to deliver, can get to and from the Passenger Client’s location safely, and can deliver the Services in the requested time period.

2.11 No Street Hails and Cash Payments. You will not, while providing the Services, operate as a public carrier or taxi service, accept street hails, charge for rides (except as expressly provided in this Agreement), demand that a rider pay in cash, or use a credit card reader, such as a Square Reader, to accept payment or engage in any other activity in a manner that is inconsistent with Your obligations under this Agreement.

3.         SOFTWARE CLIENT OBLIGATIONS

Wingz and Driver Client desire to enter into a supplier relationship that grants Driver Client the right to access Wingz’s technology for Driver Client’s Passenger Clients.

3.1 Rights. Subject to the terms of these Terms and Conditions, Wingz hereby grants You the non-exclusive, revocableright to use the Wingz Software to locate Passenger Clients, accept Open Requests,  and offer Services in exchange for payment from Wingz. These rights will terminate upon suspension or termination of Your status as a Driver Client.

3.2 Network. You shall have the right to use Wingz’s Software and functionalities for the acquisition of and communications with Passenger Clients. These Terms and Conditions do not limit or otherwise restrict Your ability to use other software platforms to provide similar Services.

4.         INDEPENDENT CONTRACTOR RELATIONSHIP

Wingz provides motivated individuals with the opportunity to establish and grow their own business. You are notrequired to work any particular schedule, expected to work a certain amount of hours, or even provide services at all.You are an independent contractor who decides when and if You want to provide transportation to Passenger Clientsthrough use of the Wingz Software. You are free to work with other companies if You so choose. As an independent contractor, You rely on Your own skill, education, and training in performing under these Terms and Conditions, if You choose to do so; You are solely responsible for Your actions and inactions; and You are solely responsible for determining the manner and means by which You provide services to the Passenger Clients You decide to offer services to (subject to these Terms and Conditions). Accordingly, nothing in these Terms and Conditions is intended to or should be construed as creating a partnership, joint venture, agency, or employer-employee relationship betweenWingz and You or between the Passenger Client and you. You are not an employee or agent of Wingz or the PassengerClient; You may not act as or represent to any third party that You are an employee or agent of Wingz or the PassengerClient; and You are not authorized, and must not represent to any third party that You are authorized, to make any contract, agreement, obligation, or commitment, or otherwise act, on behalf of Wingz or the Passenger Client. You shall not undertake or allow any actions contrary to the letter and spirit of these Terms and Conditions. Nothing herein should be construed to prevent or prohibit You from performing work for other individuals or entities while performing services pursuant to these Terms and Conditions.

4.1 Benefits and Contributions. You (and Your spouse and dependents) are not entitled to or eligible for any benefits that Wingz or other related entities may make available to its employees, such as group insurance, workers’ compensation insurance benefits, stock-options, profit-sharing or retirement benefits. You waive all rights to such benefits, including any right to file a claim for any employee benefits under the Employee Retirement Income Security Act (ERISA), applicable state or local law, or any Wingz policy, practice, procedure, or program. Because You are a Driver Client and an independent contractor, Wingz will not withhold or make payments for income or payroll taxes or socialsecurity, make unemployment insurance or disability insurance contributions, or obtain workers’ compensationinsurance on Your behalf. If, notwithstanding the foregoing, You are reclassified as an employee of Wingz, or any affiliate of Wingz (“Affiliate”), by the U.S. Internal Revenue Service (“IRS”), the U.S. Department of Labor (“DOL”), an arbitrator, or any other federal, state or foreign court or agency, You agree that You will not, as the result of such reclassification, be entitled to or eligible for, on either a prospective or retrospective basis, any employeebenefits under any plans or programs established or maintained by either Wingz or any of its parents, subsidiaries, affiliates or related entities or by the Passenger Client and any related persons or entities.

4.2 Taxes. You are solely responsible for filing all tax returns and submitting all payments as required by any federal,state, local, or foreign tax authority arising from the payment of Payments to You under these Terms and Conditions, and You agree to do so in a timely manner. You agree that You will comply with all applicable federal, state, local, and foreign laws governing self-employed individuals, including laws requiring the payment of taxes, such as incomeand employment taxes, and social security, disability and other contributions. To the extent required by the IRS and state or local tax authorities, Wingz will report the Payments paid to You for services rendered as part of Wingzengagements by filing Form 1099-K or 1099-MISC with such tax authorities. You agree to indemnify Wingz and hold Wingz harmless for the cost of any tax liabilities, interest and penalties incurred by Wingz as a result of Your failure to pay all applicable taxes in a timely manner.

5.         CONFIDENTIALITY

5.1 Use and Disclosure. From time to time, You may be given access to confidential information in the course ofperforming engagements that You receive through Wingz. “Confidential Information” means any and all informationrelated to Wingz’s or any Passenger Clients or their business (including information about the Application and identityof Passenger Clients, other trade secrets, technical information, business forecasts and strategies, marketing plans, customer and supplier lists, guest lists, personal information about Passenger Clients, personnel information, financial data, and proprietary information of third parties including Passenger Clients) that Wingz and/or the Passenger Client considers to be confidential or proprietary or Wingz has a duty to treat as confidential. Confidential Information will also include (i) all information relating to any Passenger Client’s Protected Health Information (“PHI”) as that term is defined under the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act of 1996 (“HIPAA”); financial documents and plans; healthcare service delivery methods; patient records; patient lists; healthcare provider information; technical healthcare data; proprietary healthcare concepts; privacy and security measures for PHI; and any other non-public patient or healthcare-related information; and (ii) all other non-public information provided to You or otherwise obtained by You from Wingz, a Passenger Client, or any other party in connection with Your performance of Services that is related to PHI or compliance with HIPAA.

During the term of these Terms and Conditions and at all times thereafter, You will (a) hold all Confidential Information in strict trust and confidence, (b) refrain from using or permitting others to use Confidential Information in any manner or for any purpose not expressly permitted or required by these Terms and Conditions, and (c) refrain from disclosing or permitting others to disclose any Confidential Information to any third party without obtaining Wingz’s express prior written consent on a case-by-case basis.

5.2 Exceptions. Your obligations under Sections 5.1 will terminate with respect to any particular information that You can prove, by clear and convincing evidence, (a) You lawfully knew prior to Wingz’s first disclosure to you, (b) a third party rightfully disclosed to You free of any confidentiality duties or obligations, or (c) is, or through no fault of You has become, generally available to the public. Additionally, You will be permitted to disclose ConfidentialInformation to the extent that such disclosure is expressly approved in writing by Wingz, or is required by law or court order, provided that You immediately notify Wingz in writing of such required disclosure and cooperate with Wingz, at Wingz’s reasonable request and expense, in any lawful action to contest or limit the scope of such requireddisclosure, including filing motions and otherwise making appearances before a court.

5.3 Removal; Return. Upon termination or expiration of these Terms and Conditions, You will promptly (a) return to Wingz or, if so directed by Wingz, destroy all Confidential Information (in every form and medium) relating to Wingz,the Application, and Passenger Clients who have used the Application, (b) permanently erase all electronic filescontaining or summarizing any Confidential Information, and (c) certify to Wingz in writing that You have fully complied with these obligations.

6.         RESPONSIBILITIES OF WINGZ

Wingz will use its commercially reasonable best efforts to perform the following tasks.

6.1 Fulfillment. Wingz shall provide software-as-a-service enabling Driver Clients the optional ability to review and accept Open Requests made by Passenger Clients.

6.2 Collection System. Wingz shall provide software-as-a-service to enable Driver Client to collect payments from Wingz in exchange for performing Services.

6.3 Maintenance. Wingz shall provide ongoing maintenance, support and upgrade of Wingz’s Web-based system and mobile applications.

6.4 Support. Wingz shall provide e-mail technical support according to Wingz’s existing standards.

6.5 Product Orientation. As part of its service to Driver Client, Wingz shall provide mandatory Product Orientation to Driver Client on the use of Wingz’s software-as-a-service and, per applicable state or local law, ordinance or regulation, safe operation of the vehicle used to provide services to Passenger Clients.

6.6 Magnetic Decal. Wingz shall sell a magnetic decal to Driver Client to place on Driver Client’s vehicle when giving rides (to comply with state or local legal requirements).

7.         PRICING, FEES, AND PAYMENT TERMS

Pricing. The Fare for a Passenger Client is determined based upon rates set by Wingz (“Wingz Rate”), or rates set by a partner (“Partner Rate”). You receive the entire Fare, subject to deductions of Wingz’s Platform Fees and any adjustments deemed appropriate by Wingz.

For trips based on a Wingz Rate, the Platform Fees consist of a General Ride Request Platform Fee or a Direct Book Ride Request Platform Fee, which are calculated based on the fee schedule set forth on the Wingz website, available at https://wingz.com/drivers/fees.

For trips based on a Partner Rate, which include non-emergency medical transportation (“NEMT”) trips, the Platform Fees will vary from partner to partner.

The Platform Fees are intended to compensate Wingz for the Passenger Client’s and Driver Client’s use of Wingz’s software and may change in the future upon written notice to you.

When You accept a trip from within the Application, You expressly acknowledge and agree to the Fare amount, which is calculated up front and displayed within the Application. You also agree that failure to operate the Application in accordance with orientation materials provided by Wingz may result in further adjustments to Your share of the Fare as deemed appropriate by Wingz.

7.1 Collection of Fare and Payment. Wingz utilizes a third-party provider to collect from each Passenger Client theFare charged for Services provided by You. The third-party provider shall pay the entire Fare to you, subject to any deductions of the Wingz Platform Fee and any offset for Late Cancellation Fees. You authorize the third-party provider to pay Wingz the applicable Platform Fee and any applicable fees included in the Fare. You receive paymentfor the services You provide on a weekly basis. Contact information for the third-party provider shall be provided upon written request.

7.2 Cancellation or No-Show Fees. For trips based on a Wingz Rate, in the event You cancel an accepted Open Request or Direct Booking Request, You authorize Wingz and its third-party provider to apply and deduct a late cancellation fee as outlined in the cancellation and no-show fee schedule set forth on the Wingz website, available at https://wingz.com/drivers/fees. You expressly acknowledge and agree that these potential fees may result in You notgenerating a profit and potentially sustaining loss in providing services under the terms of these Terms and Conditions.

For trips based on a Partner Rate, cancellation or no-show fees, when applicable, will vary from partner to partner.

8.         NO CONFLICTS

You represent and warrant that You are not subject to any contract or duty that would be breached by entering into orperforming Your obligations under these Terms and Conditions, or any Wingz Engagement, or that is otherwiseinconsistent with these Terms and Conditions or any Wingz Engagement. These Terms and Conditions are not exclusive and do not limit Your ability to use Your car for other purposes.

Will fully conform to the specifications, requirements, and other terms in the applicable Wingz Engagementand these Terms and Conditions and will be of a professional and workmanlike quality.

11.      TERMINATION
